messages:
alexa: trying to cut release 2026.3.1 to prod but deploy-bot keeps rejecting with 'insufficient privileges'. I thought the deployers group still has prod push rights? @jordan @matt

deploy-bot: [AUTO] deploy request blocked for alexa: reason=missing_mfa_for_role(prod-deployer), action=REQUEST_JIT or CONTACT_ONCALL. See https://idp.redwood.example/access for details.

jordan: We're on the new prod MFA enforcement — rolled last night during the rotation window. If you haven't used the new MFA device in 7 days, JIT is required. Did you try the idp flow?

alexa: I tried the flow, it fails at the final step with \"token expired\". CI job also errored earlier: pipeline says service-account-token invalid. Might be related?

matt: hmm, during rotation we removed old static membership from the deployers group and moved folks to the rotating role. If your session was long-lived it may have been evicted. Two quick options: 1) request JIT via idp (preferred) 2) ask ops oncall for temporary elevation for 15m.

sara: +1 on JIT. If the CI service account lost the role, that's a separate perms ticket. CI uses sa-deploy@infra; we rotated its key yesterday and forgot to reattach role binding. I can open infra ticket now.

alexa: ok opened a JIRA: INFRA-8242 for CI SA role binding and created an access request in the IdP with reason \"deploy 2026.3.1\". But idpctl CLI keeps failing locally. Any CLI example?

jordan: use this: `idpctl request-access --role prod-deployer --duration 15m --reason \"prod deploy 2026.3.1\"` then `idpctl approve --totp` (if you have an approved device). If CLI errors, try the web flow at https://idp.redwood.example/requests and attach your ticket number.

alexa: ran the CLI after re-seeding my MFA app, got the JIT approval code. deploy-bot now shows: pending canary start.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] canary deploy started for release=2026.3.1, cluster=prod-us-east-1, route=api-main. canary_id=canary-2026-03-1-az1.

matt: FYI we pinned the runtime image for this release to rwinf/runtime:5.4.2 to avoid the new kernel changes. Keeping a close eye on latency metrics.

sara: infra ticket updated: INFRA-8242 fixed — reattached role-binding to sa-deploy. CI pipeline retriggered and passed tests.

ops-oncall: noted. If anything fails during canary escalate to #incidents and call pager. I can also add you to the emergency deployers rota for future quick grants.

alexa: canary looks good at +10m, no errors, latency ok. Proceeding to full. Thanks everyone. :tada:

deploy-bot: [AUTO] full deploy successful for 2026.3.1. release_notes_url=https://releases.redwood.example/2026.3.1

jordan: closing loop — we'll add a short runbook to the deploy docs about the recent rotation and CLI tips. Also scheduling a follow-up doc to prevent CI SA regressions.

matt: note for next rotation: add a pre-check script to CI that validates role bindings and MFA freshness to fail fast.

alexa: thanks all — closing thread.
